title: The Per-Unit Retain Collected Alongside a Storage Settlement
content:
Bushels stored under a programme that earns patronage carry the per-unit retain, which is collected with the storage settlement and credited to the member's equity. This rule governs Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements, and the retain is added to the total drawn into the settlement.

## Clause

Where the programme earns patronage and fifteen thousand bushels or more were taken into store under the agreement in the last twelve months, the retain is the programme's per-unit rate on every bushel taken in over those twelve months, rounded to the nearest cent.

Where the programme earns patronage and fewer bushels were taken in, the minimum retain of 20.00 is collected instead.

And otherwise no retain is collected.

## Patronage standing and the per-unit rate by programme

| Programme | Bushels earn patronage | Per-unit rate (USD per bushel) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Open Storage Account | no | 0.0000 |
| Grain Bank Deposit Account | yes | 0.0020 |
| Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage | yes | 0.0020 |
| Seasonal Paid-Up Storage Agreement | yes | 0.0020 |
| Conditioned Reserve Storage Agreement | yes | 0.0020 |
| Identity Preserved Segregated Storage | yes | 0.0020 |

## Reading it condition by condition

| Programme earns patronage | Bushels taken into store under the agreement in the last twelve months | Retain collected |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | 15000 or more | the per-unit rate on every bushel taken in over the twelve months, rounded to the nearest cent |
| yes | fewer than 15000 | 20.00 |
| no | any quantity | none |

The threshold is read as at or above: 15000 bushels exactly takes the first line, and 14999 takes the second.

## Worked retains, on hypothetical figures

**A Conditioned Reserve Storage Agreement with 24500 bushels taken in over the twelve months.** The programme earns patronage and the threshold is reached, so the retain is 24500 bushels at 0.0020 for each bushel, which is 49.00.

**A Grain Bank Deposit Account with 6200 bushels taken in over the twelve months.** The programme earns patronage but the threshold is not reached, so the minimum retain of 20.00 is collected.

**An Open Storage Account with 40000 bushels taken in over the twelve months.** That programme earns no patronage, so no retain is collected whatever the quantity.
